# POC Implementation Plan — Prism (Talk to your HybridShelf) with Normalization Pipeline & Debug Panel

**Stack (decided):** React (Vite) frontend · FastAPI backend · Qdrant (Docker, local) · Anthropic API (chat + normalization + query understanding) · OpenAI `text-embedding-3-small` (dense embeddings) · Qdrant built-in BM25 (sparse)
**Data:** synthetic, deliberately messy catalog (~60–100 products) generated by script.
**Philosophy:** minimum code that proves the architecture; nothing speculative; every phase ends with a verifiable check.

---

## 0. Explicit Assumptions (flagged, not silent)

| # | Assumption | Why safe for POC | Revisit before live |
|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | Plans modeled with optional `billing_period` (`one_time` \| `monthly` \| `annual`) since recurring-vs-one-time is unanswered | Schema supports both; synthetic data includes both | Yes — lock down |
| A2 | User country selectable via dropdown in chat header (simulates known locale) | Sidesteps the "is country known?" open question while demoing multi-currency filtering | Yes |
| A3 | Source = generated JSONL files (no real extractor) | Extract stage is source-specific anyway | Yes — write real extractor |
| A4 | Review queue is a simple page in the same React app (not a separate admin tool) | Enough to prove the flag→human→override loop | Maybe |
| A5 | Single Qdrant collection for products; KB collection **out of scope** for POC | Keeps POC focused on the core blocker (requirement → retrieval → pitch) | Yes — add KB layer |
| A6 | No auth, no multi-tenant, no rate limiting | POC runs locally | Yes |

**Out of scope (deliberately):** KB article RAG layer, webhook/fast-lane price sync, alias-swap rebuilds (single collection recreate is fine locally), production deployment, streaming token-by-token (nice-to-have, Phase 7 stretch).

## 2. Schemas (`backend/app/schemas.py` — the single contract)

All stages validate against these Pydantic models; the React debug panel renders them as-is. Field lists are final for the POC.

### 2.1 RawProduct (synthetic generator output — intentionally messy)
```python
class RawPriceList(BaseModel):
    name: str; country: str; currency: str      # messy: "india"/"IN"/"In", "inr"/"₹"
    amount: float; discount: float | None = None
    discount_strategy: str | None = None        # messy free text
class RawPlan(BaseModel):
    id: str; name: str
    feature_text: str | None = None             # sometimes empty, sometimes prose
    price_lists: list[RawPriceList]
class RawProduct(BaseModel):
    id: str; name: str
    category: str | None                        # messy: "Automation"/"automations"/None
    unit: str | None; kb_article: str | None
    description: str                            # HTML fragments, marketing fluff,
                                                # contradictions, missing info
    plans: list[RawPlan]
    updated_at: str
```

### 2.2 StagedProduct (after deterministic pre-processing)
```python
class StagedPrice(BaseModel):
    country: str          # ISO-3166 alpha-2
    currency: str         # ISO-4217
    amount: float; discounted_amount: float | None
class StagedPlan(BaseModel):
    id: str; name: str; feature_text: str | None
    prices: list[StagedPrice]
class StagedProduct(BaseModel):
    id: str
    name: str; category_raw: str | None
    description_text: str                # HTML stripped, whitespace collapsed
    unit: str | None; kb_article: str | None
    plans: list[StagedPlan]
    price_min: dict[str, float]          # per currency, e.g. {"INR": 1800}
    price_max: dict[str, float]
    content_hash: str                    # over name+description+category+plan text
    needs_normalization: bool            # hash ledger diff
```

### 2.3 NormalizationRecord (LLM output, structured-output enforced)
```python
class Flag(BaseModel):
    type: Literal["ambiguous_attribute","contradiction","missing_required",
                  "suspected_duplicate","cant_categorize","plans_indistinguishable"]
    field: str; issue: str
    options: list[str]; recommended: str
class Normalized(BaseModel):
    clean_description: str               # 2-3 factual sentences, no fluff/prices
    short_pitch: str                     # one line
    category_path: str                   # from vocab/categories.yaml ONLY
    use_case_tags: list[str]             # from vocab ONLY
    target_audience: list[str]           # from vocab ONLY
    aliases: list[str]
    plan_features: dict[str, list[str]]  # plan_id -> differentiators
class NormalizationRecord(BaseModel):
    product_id: str; schema_version: int = 1
    normalized: Normalized
    confidence: float; flags: list[Flag]
```

### 2.4 CanonicalProduct (three-layer merge; feeds embedding + payload)
```python
class Offering(BaseModel):               # generalized plan/variation
    id: str; name: str
    features: list[str]
    billing_period: Literal["one_time","monthly","annual"] | None  # A1
    prices: list[StagedPrice]
class CanonicalProduct(BaseModel):
    # Layer 1 — universal core
    id: str; kind: Literal["service","subscription","digital_good"] = "service"
    title: str; brand_or_provider: str | None
    category_path: str; clean_description: str; short_pitch: str
    use_case_tags: list[str]; target_audience: list[str]; aliases: list[str]
    price_min: dict[str, float]; price_max: dict[str, float]
    availability: Literal["available","unavailable"] = "available"
    status: Literal["active","retired"] = "active"
    offerings: list[Offering]
    # Layer 2 — kind block (POC: minimal)
    service_details: dict = {}
    # Layer 3 — namespaced attributes
    attributes: dict[str, Any] = {}
    # Pipeline metadata
    content_hash: str; review_pending: bool = False
    schema_version: int = 1
```

### 2.5 Qdrant point
- `id`: product id (UUID-mapped) · vectors: `dense` (1536-d) + `sparse` (BM25)
- payload = `CanonicalProduct.model_dump()` + `display_card: dict[str, str]` (per currency) + `embedding_text: str` (stored for debug panel transparency)
- Payload indexes: `category_path` (keyword), `use_case_tags` (keyword), `target_audience` (keyword), `status` (keyword), `review_pending` (bool), `offerings[].prices[].country` (keyword), `offerings[].prices[].amount` (float), `offerings[].billing_period` (keyword).

### 2.6 SearchRequest (query-understanding tool schema, also the `search_products` tool)
```python
class SearchRequest(BaseModel):
    semantic_query: str                          # rewritten cumulative intent
    category_path: str | None = None
    use_case_tags: list[str] = []
    target_audience: list[str] = []
    price_max: float | None = None               # number only; currency bound by code
    billing_period: str | None = None
    top_k: int = 8
```

### 2.7 ChatTurn API contract (`POST /chat`)
```jsonc
// request
{ "session_id": "s1", "country": "IN",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"..."}, ...] }
// response
{ "reply": "...",
  "product_cards": [{"id":"prod_7","title":"...","pitch":"...","price_display":"₹1,800/mo"}],
  "debug": {                                    // the debug panel's food
    "turn_flow": ["received","llm_decided_search","filters_extracted",
                  "qdrant_query","fallback_none","injected_6_cards","llm_pitched"],
    "extracted_filters": { /* SearchRequest */ },
    "qdrant_query": { "filter": {...}, "fusion": "rrf" },
    "hits": [{"id":"...","dense_score":0.71,"sparse_score":12.3,
              "rrf_rank":1,"payload_excerpt":{...}}],
    "fallback": {"triggered": false, "action": null},
    "injected_prompt_block": "…the literal product-card text sent to the LLM…",
    "tokens": {"query_understanding": 412, "final": 1630},
    "latency_ms": {"extract": 900, "qdrant": 12, "final_llm": 2100}
  }}
```

## 3. Phase Plan (each phase ends with a verify gate)

### Phase 1 — Scaffold & Infra (½ day)
Docker compose for Qdrant; FastAPI skeleton with `/health`; Vite React app with split layout shell; `.env` wiring.
**Verify:** `curl localhost:6333/collections` OK; frontend renders two empty panes; `/health` returns keys-present booleans.

### Phase 2 — Synthetic Messy Catalog (½ day)
`generate_synthetic.py`: ~60–100 service/SaaS products across 4–5 categories (scheduling, CRM, invoicing, marketing, support). Injected messiness — this is the point of synthetic data, keep it deliberate and labeled:
- ~20% HTML-laden descriptions with marketing fluff ("BEST IN CLASS!!").
- ~10% contradictions (name says "Pro Suite", description describes basic tier).
- ~10% missing/None category or unit; a few near-duplicate products.
- Messy country/currency casing; mixed one_time and monthly plans; some plans with identical feature_text (→ should trigger `plans_indistinguishable`).
- Each injected defect logged to `data/raw/defect_manifest.json` so we can later measure flag recall.
**Verify:** JSONL validates against `RawProduct`; defect manifest counts match generation parameters.

### Phase 3 — Pipeline Stages 1–4 (1½–2 days, the core)
1. `s1_preprocess.py` — deterministic cleaning, ISO canonicalization, plan/price resolution, validation → dead_letter, hash ledger diff.
   **Verify:** rerun on unchanged raw → 0 products marked `needs_normalization`; dead_letter contains exactly the invalid ones.
2. `s2_normalize.py` — Anthropic structured output (tool-use mode against `NormalizationRecord` schema), vocab injected into prompt, batch of 5 products/call, retry-once-then-dead-letter, override short-circuit, confidence/flag routing → `review_queue.jsonl`.
   **Verify (measured, not vibes):** run over full synthetic set → compare flags vs `defect_manifest.json`; target ≥ 70% of injected defects flagged, ≤ 15% of clean products flagged. Tune prompt until met.
3. `s3_merge.py` — Canonical merge + embedding-text template + per-currency display_card.
   **Verify:** every canonical validates; spot-check 5 embedding texts contain no prices/IDs/HTML.
4. `s4_index.py` — OpenAI embeddings (only changed hashes), sparse BM25 via Qdrant inference, upsert, create payload indexes, post-run integrity count check.
   **Verify:** point count == active canonical count; a hand-written hybrid query for "appointment booking" returns the scheduling products in top-5.

### Phase 4 — RAG Serving (1 day)
`query_understanding.py` (history-aware filter extraction via tool schema), `search.py` (Qdrant Query API: filter → dense+sparse prefetch → RRF; fallback ladder: zero hits → drop `price_max`+20% → drop tags → semantic-only, each step recorded in trace), `chat.py` (Claude agent loop with `search_products` tool; system prompt: gather requirements conversationally, ask ONE narrowing question when results too broad/vague, pitch with card IDs, never invent prices — quote only from injected cards).
**Verify:** scripted 3-turn conversation ("I run a salon" → "under 2000" → "monthly billing") narrows results correctly at each turn; a query with no matches triggers and reports fallback.

### Phase 5 — Chat UI (1 day)
Chat pane: message list, product cards rendered from `product_cards` (title, pitch, price for selected country, plan chips), country selector (A2), typing indicator. Plain fetch, no streaming (stretch: SSE).
**Verify:** full conversation flows in browser; switching country changes quoted prices without re-embedding anything.

### Phase 6 — Developer Debug Panel (1 day) — see §6 for exact content
**Verify:** every element of the `debug` object in §2.7 is visible in the panel for the latest turn; clicking a hit opens its full payload; mindmap highlights the actual path taken this turn (including fallback branches).

### Phase 7 — Review Queue UI + polish (½–1 day)
`ReviewQueue.tsx`: one flag per card — issue text, tap options (recommended pre-highlighted), free-text field; answers `POST` to overrides; "re-run pipeline" button calls `/pipeline/run`, after which the product's `review_pending` clears.
**Verify:** answer a flag → rerun → product's canonical reflects the human choice; the flag is never re-asked (override short-circuit works).
Stretch: SSE streaming; export debug trace as JSON.

**Total estimate: ~6–7 focused days.**

## 4. Prompts (POC versions, kept in code as constants)

1. **Normalization prompt** — role: catalog data engineer; inputs: product semantic fields + vocab lists; rules: closed vocab only, no prices/fluff in clean_description, flag don't guess, flag only filter-affecting ambiguity; output: `NormalizationRecord` via forced tool use.
2. **Query-understanding tool description** — "Extract the user's cumulative product requirements from the full conversation as of the latest message. Rewrite, don't append." Currency note: extract bare numbers; server binds currency from session country.
3. **Chat system prompt** — sales-assistant persona; must call `search_products` before recommending; if >12 hits or vague intent → ask exactly one narrowing question; pitch max 3 products referencing `[ID]`s; prices only from injected cards; if fallback was triggered, say so honestly ("nothing under ₹X, closest is…").

## 5. Fallback & Edge Behavior (implemented, traced, visible in panel)

| Situation | Behavior | Trace event |
|---|---|---|
| 0 hits | Relax price +20% → drop soft tags → semantic-only | `fallback.step_n` |
| >12 hits / vague | Bot asks one narrowing question, no dump | `narrowing_question` |
| LLM returns invalid filter JSON | One retry, then semantic-only search | `filter_parse_retry` |
| Product `review_pending` | Included, badge shown in debug hits (POC choice) | `hit.review_pending` |
| No search needed (small talk) | No tool call; panel shows `llm_decided_no_search` | — |

## 6. Debug Panel — exact contents (tabs)

1. **Turn Flow (mindmap):** static graph of the serving pipeline (user msg → decide → extract → filter → hybrid search → RRF → fallback? → inject → pitch); nodes traversed this turn light up, with per-node latency. Same component reused with the ETL graph (raw → preprocess → normalize → merge → index) on the Pipeline page, lighting up per-stage doc counts from `/pipeline/status`.
2. **Extracted Filters:** pretty-printed `SearchRequest` + diff vs previous turn (shows filter accumulation working).
3. **Retrieval:** the literal Qdrant filter JSON; hits table (rank, id, title, dense score, sparse score, RRF position, review_pending badge); click → full payload + stored `embedding_text`.
4. **Fallback:** ladder steps attempted and which succeeded.
5. **Injected Prompt:** the verbatim product-card block sent to the chat LLM — the single most useful debugging artifact.
6. **Cost/Latency:** tokens per LLM call, ms per stage, running session totals.

## 7. Setup & Demo Script (README contents)

```bash
docker compose up -d                     # qdrant
cp .env.example .env                     # add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY
cd backend && uv sync && uv run python -m app.pipeline.generate_synthetic
uv run python -m app.pipeline.run_pipeline          # stages 1-4, prints summary
uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload
cd ../frontend && npm i && npm run dev
```
Demo path: open app → Review Queue (resolve 2 flags, rerun) → chat: "I run a small salon and drowning in appointment calls" → watch panel extract intent → "keep it under 2000 a month" → watch filter accumulate + price bind to INR → bot pitches 2–3 cards → ask "what's the difference between Basic and Pro?" → answered from injected `plan_features`.

## 8. Cost Estimate (POC, order of magnitude)

Embeddings: ~100 products × ~200 tokens ≈ trivial (<$0.01). Normalization: ~100 products / 5 per call × ~2K tokens ≈ 40–80K tokens ≈ a few tens of cents. Chat: ~$0.01–0.05 per demo conversation. **Total: well under $5 for the whole POC including iteration.**

## 9. POC → Production Gap List (so the POC's shortcuts are never forgotten)

Real extractor for the actual source system (open question #1) · lock billing model (A1) · country from real session/locale (A2) · KB article second collection + product_id-filtered detail RAG · alias-swap rebuilds + scheduled runs / webhook fast-lane (`set_payload`) · structured discount strategy before the bot quotes discounts · vocabulary governance workflow (propose→approve two-pass) · auth/observability/rate limits · flag-recall measurement on a real-data sample before trusting auto-accept threshold.
